# Sandbox Kit

Sandbox Kit is a multi-provider SDK for creating and managing cloud sandboxes
from one portable API. Install the public client and the provider you need;
each provider initializes its official SDK from shared configuration.

Go and TypeScript share the same contracts, validation rules, error kinds, and
example matrix for [Daytona](docs/providers.md) and [Modal](docs/providers.md).
Both languages cover authentication, creation, supported lifecycle operations,
copied metadata, and common error handling. Execution, storage, GPU requests,
and harness integrations are planned.

## What's included

| Area              | Status                                                                 |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Languages         | Go 1.26.9+, TypeScript on Node.js 20 / 22 / 24.15+                     |
| Providers         | Daytona and Modal (optional modules; official SDKs underneath)         |
| Public API        | Client construction, create, get/attach, lifecycle, close              |
| Contracts         | Protobuf under `proto/`; SDK packages alias the generated types        |
| Examples          | Independent projects under `examples/go/` and `examples/typescript/`   |
| Local development | Modules and packages use checkout-local replacements, not published releases |

Applications never depend on a middle Kit service. Closing a client or handle
releases local SDK resources only; it does not stop, terminate, archive, or
delete a cloud sandbox.

## Get started

Clone the repository. Examples use local replacements, so run them from this
checkout.

### Go

Requires Go 1.26.9 or newer.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit.git
cd kit/examples/go/daytona/create-daytona-sandbox
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY in .env.
go run .
```

Modal setup (token pair and an existing app) is in the
[Go Modal creation guide](examples/go/modal/create-modal-sandbox/README.md).

### TypeScript

Requires Node.js 24.15.0 (or a supported Node.js 20/22 release) and npm 11.19.0.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit.git
cd kit/examples/typescript/daytona/create-daytona-sandbox
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY in .env.
npm install
npm run build
npm start
```

Modal setup for TypeScript is in the
[TypeScript Modal creation guide](examples/typescript/modal/create-modal-sandbox/README.md).

Skip copying `.env.example` if you already have a configured `.env`. Credentials
stay in Git-ignored files; the SDKs do not load dotenv themselves.

### What the examples do

- Creation examples provision real sandboxes (one each, except the linked
  Daytona example, which creates a parent and a child).
- Lifecycle examples operate on the sandbox ID in `.env`. Destructive examples
  stop, terminate, archive, or delete that sandbox as their names indicate.
- Error-handling examples exercise local failures without cloud creation.
- Closing the client or a handle releases only local resources.

Full indexes: [Go examples](examples/go/README.md) ·
[TypeScript examples](examples/typescript/README.md) ·
[all examples](examples/README.md).

    "fmt"
    "os"

    "github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox"

        return

    switch sandboxError.Kind {
    case sandbox.ErrorKindInvalidArgument, sandbox.ErrorKindUnsupported:
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Check %s: %s\n", sandboxError.Field, sandboxError.Message)

# Daytona provider

Optional Go module over the official Daytona SDK v0.222.0. Use it through the
shared Sandbox Kit client. Requires Go 1.26.9 or newer and this checkout (local
module replacements).

## Usage

```go
import (
    "context"
    "os"
    "time"

    "github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/daytona"
    "github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox"
)

config := &sandbox.Config{
    Auth: &sandbox.AuthConfig{
        Credentials: &sandbox.AuthConfig_ApiKey{
            ApiKey: &sandbox.APIKeyCredentials{Key: os.Getenv("DAYTONA_API_KEY")},
        },
    },
    Timeout: sandbox.Duration(2 * time.Minute),
}
client, err := sandbox.NewClient(daytona.New(), config)
if err != nil {
    return err
}
defer client.Close(context.Background())

// Default snapshot:
instance, err := client.Create(ctx, nil)

// Or an image with resource requests:
instance, err := client.Create(ctx, &sandbox.CreateOptions{
    Source: &sandbox.SandboxSource{
        Kind: &sandbox.SandboxSource_Image{
            Image: &sandbox.ImageSource{Reference: "python:3.11"},
        },
    },
    Resources: &sandbox.Resources{
        CpuCores:  sandbox.Value(2.0),
        MemoryMib: sandbox.Value(uint64(4096)),
        DiskMib:   sandbox.Value(uint64(8192)),
    },
})
```

Check `err`, then use `instance.ID()` or `instance.Info()`. Closing the client
releases local SDK resources only.

## Examples

| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Creation   | [create-daytona-sandbox](../../../../examples/go/daytona/create-daytona-sandbox/README.md) |
| Policies   | [create-daytona-with-policies](../../../../examples/go/daytona/create-daytona-with-policies/README.md) |
| Retrieval  | [get-daytona-sandbox](../../../../examples/go/daytona/get-daytona-sandbox/README.md) |
| Full index | [Go Daytona examples](../../../../examples/go/README.md)                             |

## Configuration

| Client setting   | Support                           |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------- |
| API key          | Supported                         |
| Bearer/JWT token | Supported; organization required  |
| Omitted auth     | Native SDK environment resolution |
| Scope            | Organization ID                   |
| Endpoint         | `Config.Endpoint` maps to API URL |
| Region           | `Config.Region` maps to target    |

Organization and target may use SDK environment defaults when omitted. An omitted
endpoint resolves from `DAYTONA_API_URL`, then `DAYTONA_SERVER_URL`, then
`https://app.daytona.io/api`. Explicit `Config.Endpoint` takes precedence.
Remote endpoints require HTTPS; HTTP is accepted for localhost or literal loopback
IPs. See [common configuration](../../../../docs/configuration.md).

CPU requests must be whole cores. Memory/disk requests must be whole GiB
expressed as MiB. Snapshot creation inherits resources, so overrides require an
image. Account quotas remain provider-enforced.

Toolbox languages are `python`, `javascript`, and `typescript`. Per-request
placement is unsupported; use the client's region/target.

## Creation policies

| Request                      | Mapping                                      |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| Default/absent policy        | Omitted; provider default applies            |
| Disabled stop/pause          | Native zero                                  |
| Immediate delete             | Native zero                                  |
| Immediate stop/pause/archive | Rejected                                     |
| Disabled archive/delete      | Rejected by the current creation integration |

Archive delays cannot exceed 30 days. Conflicting idle actions and ephemeral
policies fail local validation. See [creation semantics](../../../../docs/sandbox-creation.md).

## Ownership and verification

Errors expose shared kinds and preserve native SDK causes. Handles support
`Start`, `Stop`, `Pause`, `Archive`, `Delete`, and `Refresh`; class-dependent
operations reject known unsupported combinations before the lifecycle call.
Call `instance.Capabilities()` or `instance.Supports(...)` for the resolved
container, VM, Windows, or GPU sandbox. Use `Client.Get` for a provider-verified
handle. Daytona does not support unverified `Client.Attach`.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

Tests use a fake HTTP transport without cloud provisioning.
[Provider YAML](../../../../specs/providers/daytona.yaml) inventories checks and
mapping groups in `provider_checks.go` and `provider_mappings.go`. `sandbox.go`
owns remaining creation orchestration. Error classification is handwritten in
`errors.go`.

See [responses and errors](../../../../docs/responses-and-errors.md),
[generation](../../../../docs/code-generation.md), and
[reference verification](../../../../docs/provider-verification.md).

    "os"
    "time"

    "github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/modal"
    "github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox"
)

    Auth: &sandbox.AuthConfig{
        Credentials: &sandbox.AuthConfig_TokenPair{
            TokenPair: &sandbox.TokenPairCredentials{
                Id:     os.Getenv("MODAL_TOKEN_ID"),
                Secret: os.Getenv("MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET"),
            },
        },
    },
    Scope: &sandbox.Scope{
        AppName:     sandbox.Value("existing-app"),
        Environment: sandbox.Value("main"),
    },
    Timeout: sandbox.Duration(2 * time.Minute),
}
client, err := sandbox.NewClient(modal.New(), config)
if err != nil {
    return err
}
defer client.Close(context.Background())

instance, err := client.Create(ctx, &sandbox.CreateOptions{
    Source: &sandbox.SandboxSource{
        Kind: &sandbox.SandboxSource_Image{
            Image: &sandbox.ImageSource{Reference: "alpine:3.21"},
        },
    },
    Resources: &sandbox.Resources{
        CpuCores:  sandbox.Value(0.5),
        MemoryMib: sandbox.Value(uint64(512)),
    },
    Lifetime: &sandbox.LifetimePolicy{
        MaximumLifetime: sandbox.Duration(5 * time.Minute),
    },
})
